card.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
card.profile: "Pop! Goes the Weasel" (Roud 5249) is a traditional old English song, a country dance, nursery rhyme, and singing game that emerged in the mid-19th century. The melody is often used in jack-in-the-box toys and is frequently played by ice cream trucks.
card.insight:
Largo goes on strike allowing the students to play 'the forbidden music' which is "Pop Goes the Weasel"
In 1997's NYPD Blue (season 5), part of the plot of the episode "The Truth Is Out There" deals with the meaning of the song, "Pop Goes the Weasel.
